name: rust-coverage
//: The Rust line floor: one report over every crate's instrumented test run, held to 95%. It depends on those test targets, and on nothing else, so only a change that reaches a crate runs them.
// suppression: llmlint: ignore-file[expensive_tests_stay_behind_their_own_edge] this project is the coverage aggregate, and create-repo's coverage_combined_across_crates and coverage_combined_across_projects require it to depend on its language's test targets, which is the edge this rule objects to; the two rules contradict each other, and a follow-up asks create-repo to reconcile them. JSON has no comment to scope this to the one target.
